catalog_name: OMG Outbound Email Inspection Pattern Catalog
important_note: This is a newly consolidated and expanded working catalog, not a verified transcription of the original 112 numbered entries. Available document versions in the workspace mention 125; the project conversation identifies 112 as the corrected count, but the exact original 112-item list was not available as structured data. Review with the project lead before approving policy.
scope_note: Attachment entries define integration requirements only. The teammate implements the scanner. A required missing, failed, or incomplete inspection must not produce SAFE. Accuracy must be measured on labeled test data.
